primary_call.title: Base race plan
primary_call.summary: Medium–Soft–Medium two-stop: 5 of 17 finishers ran it at the 2025 São Paulo Grand Prix (previous regulations), the winner among them. Soft–Medium–Medium two-stop was as common. 13 of 17 finishers stopped twice. First stops: median L21, middle half L17–L30.

assumptions: Base plan: the 2025 São Paulo Grand Prix, 17 classified finishers, previous regulations. Compound sequences from OpenF1 stints; stop counts and stop laps from Jolpica pit stops; pit-lane time from OpenF1 pit-lane times; finishers from OpenF1 classification.
Compounds read Soft / Medium / Hard: the weekend's Pirelli allocation (C1–C5) is not read yet.
No undercut, overcut or rejoin-traffic figure is shown: nothing measures them yet.
